name: raw_opening_collapse_counter
hypothesis: During an opening collapse, qd1n:v89 can retreat, build, or attack a bystander while a current attacker remains legally counterattackable. Two consecutive policy-visible raw-tile declines before turn 3500 should reroute only that non-counter action to the largest safe counterattack against a verified current protocol attacker.

candidate.source_delta: Add selector-private validated own-tile history, then apply one stateless opening-only post-selection guard. Preserve the exact safety base outside the guard. Keep Gravity, katanasan, juryoku-koku, and Hrafn protection unchanged. Do not add a scheduler, persistent mode, social ban, build ban, boat ban, or planner-state branch.

causal_contract.guard: The current policy-visible turn is at most 3500; current, previous, and prior validated raw own-tile counts exist and prior > previous > current; at least one authoritative current protocol attacker ID maps to a visible non-K1Z rival; a legal non-neutral counterattack against that attacker exists; and the exact-parent selected action is not already a counterattack against any current attacker.
causal_contract.action_change: Replace only that exact-parent non-counter action with the highest-percentage safe legal counterattack against the most recently hostile verified attacker. If every verified counter is high risk, use the highest-percentage legal counter. If no verified counter exists, return the exact-parent action.
causal_contract.marker: ds2 only when the selected action ID differs from the exact-parent action ID.
causal_contract.scope: Opening only. The turn ceiling is the smallest paired-replay discriminator: the eliminated R587 loss first reaches at turn 1900 and again at 2700, while the paired R587 win first reaches a raw two-decline pattern at turn 7100.
causal_contract.failure: Reject on zero marker reach in the pressure screen, any marker in the paired official winner before turn 3500, any pre-marker divergence, any unexplained hold or rejection, any K1Z harm, or nonpositive matched post-trigger territory outcome.

source_gate.red_first: Core loss-state regression must fail on the safety base: with raw tiles 12742 -> 12297 -> 12144, turn 1900, Ron as current protocol attacker, and legal 10/25/40 counters, the base selects the parent retreat while DS2 must select Ron 40 with marker ds2.
lock_ins: paired winner state at turn 7100 is unchanged because it is outside the opening ceiling
no current protocol attacker is unchanged
an already-selected verified counter is unchanged and unmarked
raw tiles remain absent from JSON.stringify(state)
source_gate.full_suite: All tests pass and new core test is red without the DS2 implementation.

local_screen.known_parent_trace: At turn 1800, after raw tiles 13093 -> 12444 -> 12320 and a 40 percent attack from fixture ID aaljvkkc, legal 10/25/40 counters exist but the parent selects an alliance request. The parent later falls to 140 tiles.
local_screen.pass: Control reproduces the known collapse. Candidate has exact pre-marker selected-action and ordered-legal-action trace, emits ds2 on an accepted attack:aaljvkkc:40 at the first eligible reach, has zero unexplained holds/rejections/K1Z harm, and strictly improves post-trigger territory AUC and final tiles over control.
local_screen.failure: Stop DS2 immediately if the control collapse is absent, marker reach is zero, pre-marker trace diverges, any safety condition fails, or neither post-trigger territory AUC nor final tiles improves. No adjacent seeds and no broad matrix after failure.

gates.source: red-first core and lock-ins, full suite, exact linux/amd64 image byte check, qualifier accepted with zero unexplained holds/rejections/K1Z harm
gates.local: one exact deterministic pressure control/candidate pair only; direct marker reach plus strict matched territory improvement
gates.next_on_pass: One fresh bounded official-roster diagnostic cell, then the existing autonomous promotion gates. Do not expand locally before the deterministic pair passes.
